title: Structure of Generalized bi-circular idempotents and isometric reflections on $C^1[0,1]$
summary: Let $C^1[0,1]$ be the complex linear space of all continuously differentiable complex-valued functions $f$ on the unit interval $[0,1]$ with respect to the norm $ \|f\|_σ = |f(0)| +\|f'\|_\infty$. Let $P_1, P_2: C^1[0,1] \rightarrow C^1[0,1]$ be distinct, nonzero idempotent maps, which are not necessarily linear, such that $P_1P_2 = P_2P_1 = 0$ and $P_1+P_2 = I$, where $I$ denotes the identity operator. It is proved that $λ_1P_1 + λ_2P_2$ is an isometry on $C^1[0,1]$, for some distinct unit modulus complex numbers $λ_1, λ_2$, if and only if either $λ_1 + λ_2 = 0$, or $λ_1P_1 + λ_2P_2$ is an…
